conventions.raising: E_ij c_alpha = (alpha_i + 1) c_(alpha + e_i - e_j) when alpha_j > 0, extended as a derivation
conventions.basis_element: a multiset of 5 degree-4 monomials in 5 variables, stored as the sorted 5-tuple of indices into MONS; the basis vector is the product of the corresponding coefficients c_alpha
conventions.vector_normalisation: primitive integer vector, first nonzero coordinate positive
